QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Needs Food Badly
QuestInfo.0: You've made 1,500 meters up Wu Tien Mountain. Aren't you getting kinda hungry?
QuestInfo.1: You are too hungry to continue. Hunt the nearby monsters for some meat.
QuestInfo.2: You got plenty of meat, enough to share with your brothers. Unfortunately, Bonsun is a vegetarian, so she gave up and headed back down the mountain.

default.0: There has to be SOMETHING to eat around here. Nature provides, right?
